title: Concepticon 3.4.0
citation: List, Johann-Mattis et al. (eds.). 2025. CLLD Concepticon 3.4.0.

coverage.description: Linked concept sets, definitions, source-list judgments and semantic relations for lexical comparison.

limitations: A short gloss is a convenience label and must not be treated as a complete semantic definition.
Concept mappings are curated judgments and may be revised between releases.

The pinned release is concepticon-cldf v3.4.0, a CLDF Wordlist with JSON metadata and CSV tables, not a standalone JSON dataset; an execution lock must identify the archive, metadata path, selected tables and transformations.
This manifest does not pin a local payload; a downloaded payload must add its SHA-256 before use in a release build.
